name: Sou2
title: The Bamboo Duet
approval: Carl selected the two bamboo flutes on blue cloth and explicitly requested GitHub deployment. The footbridge and terracotta-wall alternatives are not selected.
originalRetention: The full-resolution original PNG is retained with the approval conversation. This repository contains the optimized approved artwork and provenance, not a full-resolution PNG archive.
processing: Uniformly resize the complete exact 3:4 RGB painting with Pillow Lanczos to 300 x 400, then encode AVIF quality 70, speed 0, 4:2:0. No cropping, stretching, repainting or recolouring. The normal exporter places the image at 0,0,300,400, with zero extra bleed. Both flutes and the complete setting are preserved apart from the standard rounded tile clipping.
